entries.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create one 8-frame animation sprite sheet: AMIGUINHO TABLE TENNIS CELEBRATION.
Input image1 is the canonical pink jelly AMIGUINHO model. Image2 is the precise4x2 layout guide only; omit all its labels, numbers, borders and lines. Image3 is the APPROVED CAMERA ANGLE and is highest priority: all eight sprites use this exact THREE-QUARTER FRONT VIEW facing slightly RIGHT, never side profile. The full broad horizontal oval visor must remain plainly visible at its full width in every frame, never reduced to a narrow sliver. Image4 is the approved table-tennis paddle model; ignore the ball.
Sheet canvas1776x888, four equal columns and two equal rows of444pxsquare cells,8frames in reading order. Do not draw cellborders. Ground atlocaly406 ineachcell. Neutral standing character topy85, standing height320px. Keep main body nearlocalx222. Same character scale in EVERY frame. Every hand and foot stays the same small size. Jelly may squash wider or stretch taller while conserving the same body volume. Roomy margin ofatleast12px aroundeverything. All sprites wholly contained within their own cells.
Design: exact pink egg-shaped jelly body from images1 and3, two round pink FLOATING BALL HANDS and two round-domed pink FLOATING FEET, NO arms, NO legs, NO fingers, NO hat, NO clothes. Full broad horizontal dark navy glossy glass visor always BLANK: no face, eyes, mouth, symbols or emotion marks. Emotion conveyed exclusively by posture. Thick organic dark navy outlines and hand-painted colorful brush textures, light consistently from upperleft.
PADDLE LOCK: ONE paddle, ALWAYS in the floating hand positioned on SCREEN-RIGHT of the character, in every frame. The screen-left hand remains free. Always grasping the cream wood handle; never switch hands, never release it. Paddle has red rubber front, thin cream wooden edge, dark navy reverse. Keep it SMALL: total length100px including handle, blade width70px in444pxcell. Same physical paddle size throughout. Hand and paddle MUST NEVER COVER ANY PART OF THE VISOR. Keep the entire visor completely unobstructed; paddle entirely below the visor in ready poses and entirely beside its outer screen-right edge when raised.
Frames:
1 ready stance, neutral jelly, paddle in screen-right hand at waist level BELOW and to right of visor; free screen-left hand relaxed.
2 anticipatory big squash, body wider/lower keeping volume, same hands/feet, paddle below-right and free hand slightly raised.
3 joyful modest jump, feet clearly lifted above ground, screen-right paddle hand raised beside upper-right body like a trophy, red face toward camera; free screen-left hand beginning to rise. Keep paddle to the RIGHT of the silhouette, never over visor.
4 apex of jump, jelly stretched taller/narrower with same volume, both floating hands raised OUTSIDE the two sides of the body, screen-right paddle high; visor completely readable. Keep jump modest so raised paddle stays insidecell.
5 descending, jelly relaxing, both feet still airborne, paddle remains on screen-right clear of visor.
6 landing squash and happy wobble, feet atground, screen-right paddle beside outer-right edge of visor with clear green gap, screen-left free hand lifted.
7 recovering happy jelly wiggle, rotate paddle around handle in SAME SCREEN-RIGHT hand so thin edge facescamera. Visor remains fully unobstructed.
8 exact return to frame1 ready stance with paddle below-right ofvisor, sameheight andposture asframe1.
Consecutive poses belong to one coherent action; do not change camera angle. Flat pure green background RGB(0,255,0). No ball, table, groundshadow, dust, motionlines, writing, numerals, border, scene, extraobjects or extra bodyparts.
